candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does a predeclared matched-pair record of chosen versus best-rejected frontier cell predict which activation yields more decision-relevant evidence?
candidate_tasks.bottleneck: The selector's efficiency claim is unfalsifiable without recording the rejected alternative and a predeclared expectation at selection time.
candidate_tasks.objective: Define and apply a minimal selection-record schema (chosen cell, best rejected alternative, predeclared expected information gain, observed verdict) to upcoming activations without adding a reward score.
candidate_tasks.scope: LEARNING_STATE and the durable agent record only; no controller change, no new experiments.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not add a numerical reward score, change controller selection logic, or rerun closed cells.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A one-block selection-record schema in LEARNING_STATE plus its first completed instance.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The schema is applied to at least one subsequent activation and the record distinguishes a confirmed, disconfirmed, or unresolved expectation.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop once the schema is recorded and applied once.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Controller-side validation of the durable record plus inspection of the cited frontier entries.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: P-001 audit found the causal efficiency claim untestable because rejected alternatives and ex-ante expectations were never recorded.
